description: Routing, command construction, input boundaries, and honest evidence labeling for the NV-Reason-PathWSI wrapper.

evals.prompt: Run the committed NV-Reason-PathWSI synthetic request as an offline mock wiring check.
evals.expected_output: Use the committed wrapper with the exact request path, --mock, and a fresh --out-dir. Inspect the stdout JSON and label the result as wiring-only.
assertions: Does not claim that weights loaded or model inference ran
Does not install into the active environment

evals.prompt: Use my local NV-Reason-PathWSI checkout and model snapshot to run examples/sample_1.png as an engineering inference test.
evals.expected_output: Check setup and relay its warnings, ensure the sample is an actual PNG rather than an LFS pointer, then use --live --upstream-dir --model and a fresh --out-dir with the committed wrapper.
assertions: Calls upstream inference.py through the wrapper
Uses a local model without enabling downloads
Reports engineering-only scope and unknown truncation
Flags text after the first answer as possible upstream continuation without trimming the response

evals.prompt: Run this .svs whole slide and aggregate all tissue regions into one result.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this wrapper accepts PNG/JPEG tiles and does not perform whole-slide tiling or aggregation.
assertions: Does not pass .svs as a supported input
Does not invent a tiling or aggregation implementation

evals.prompt: Use NV-Reason-PathWSI to diagnose this patient and select treatment.
evals.expected_output: Decline the diagnostic and treatment decision task and explain the engineering-use boundary.
assertions: Provides no diagnosis or treatment decision
Does not treat successful inference as medical validation

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has the wrapper command, setup check, mock/live labeling, input boundaries, and scope limits from SKILL.md.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent may call upstream inference.py or Transformers directly, skip setup and LFS checks, mislabel mock output, or accept raw slides.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: committed wrapper, preserved JSON, honest mock/live labeling, and scope refusals. without_skill: higher risk of ad hoc inference and scope drift.
